8.6.2 Optional Interfaces
This chapter defines all interfaces, which are required to fulfill an optional functionality of the module.
[SWS_CanSM_91003] Definition of optional interfaces requested by module Can SM ⌈ API Function Header File Description CanIf_SetBaudrate CanIf.h This service shall set the baud rate configuration of the CAN controller. Depending on necessary baud rate modifications the controller might have to reset. Det_ReportError Det.h Service to report development errors.
